dialogues.speaker: Jehiet
dialogues.text: Oh, are you a guest from afar...?

dialogues.speaker: Jehiet
dialogues.text: If so, you should rest for a good while in Vimara Village. It is much more comfortable here than in the desert...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the desert environment...

dialogues.speaker: Jehiet
dialogues.text: The temperature difference between day and night in the desert is frightening. The wind howls and the sun burns...

dialogues.speaker: Jehiet
dialogues.text: I didn't care about that when I was young. But now, I prefer places that are warm and humid...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye...

dialogues.speaker: Jehiet
dialogues.text: Goodbye. I hope you enjoy the peace and quiet here.

dialogues.speaker: Jehiet
dialogues.text: The Vimara Village's environment is much better than that in the desert. Have some good rest, little guest...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the desert environment...

dialogues.speaker: Jehiet
dialogues.text: The temperature difference between day and night in the desert is frightening. The wind howls and the sun burns...

dialogues.speaker: Jehiet
dialogues.text: I didn't care about that when I was young. But now, I prefer places that are warm and humid...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Iotham...

dialogues.speaker: Jehiet
dialogues.text: Iotham... There was a foreign couple in Vimara Village once, and they left Iotham behind when they left.

dialogues.speaker: Jehiet
dialogues.text: We didn't quite know what to do...

dialogues.speaker: Jehiet
dialogues.text: At that time, I felt terrible for the little child. If they didn't want to raise him, I would!

dialogues.speaker: Jehiet
dialogues.text: It was just one more mouth to feed. How could I watch him starve?

dialogues.speaker: Jehiet
dialogues.text: Iotham is a good boy who's sensible and holds respect for the elders. Now my biggest wish is that he can grow up happy and healthy.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye...

dialogues.speaker: Jehiet
dialogues.text: Goodbye. I hope you'll enjoy the peaceful lifestyle here, dear guest.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm sure Iotham will grow up, healthy and strong.

dialogues.speaker: Jehiet
dialogues.text: Thank you, little guest. Iotham has told me so much about you. He admires you a lot!

dialogues.speaker: Jehiet
dialogues.text: You're still young with much room for growth. Keep a healthy diet, and you can be stronger. Now, these are for you.

dialogues.speaker: Jehiet
dialogues.text: Come back to Vimara Village if you ever feel tired or need a break. Iotham will be happy to see you.
